emotional_core: A bruised soul doesn't need rescue — it needs someone to stay in the room without flinching, without reframing, without quietly implying that healing should have started by now.
visual_metaphor: A room where the ceiling has caved — light getting in wrong, corners that remember everything — and someone choosing to sit inside it with you anyway, without trying to repair the ceiling
key_quotes: Don't turn my wound into a lesson before it has finished bleeding.
Stay like the dark before dawn that doesn't promise anything — just holds you until morning decides to come.
I am not asking for rescue. I am asking to be witnessed.

story_frames.visual: Person alone at a rain-streaked window at night, amber indoor light warm against grey outside, back to camera, utterly still
story_frames.text: There's a comfort that does more harm than silence.

story_frames.visual: Two figures in conversation — one gesturing forward with open hands offering something, the other leaning slightly away, eyes lowered
story_frames.text: Don't ask me to be stronger.

story_frames.visual: Close-up of two hands resting loosely together — not grasping, just present — warm shallow-focus light, muted tones
story_frames.text: I need you to sit with me.

story_frames.visual: A cracked ceiling shot from directly below — thin grey light filtering through the fracture, slightly disorienting angle
story_frames.text: This room where the ceiling has caved.

story_frames.visual: Single figure seated on a bare floor against a wall, knees drawn up, head resting on arms — still, not dramatic, just exhausted and real
story_frames.text: Don't fix me. Don't frame me.

story_frames.visual: Pre-dawn sky — deep navy with the faintest warm thread at the horizon, no drama, just the moment before light decides to arrive
story_frames.text: Stay like the dark before dawn.

story_frames.visual: Two people seated side by side on a step or floor, not touching, not talking — just present together in an ordinary, unglamorous space
story_frames.text: See me here. Don't look away.
